text:
```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: make docker-build

    - name: Start test cluster
      run: make start-cluster

    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: make e2e TEST_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=120s
      continue-on-error: true

    - name: Collect container logs on failure
      if: failure()
      run: |
        docker-compose logs > e2e_logs.txt
        cat e2e_logs.txt

    - name: Clean up resources
      run: make clean
```
